name: Null-space redistribution
mechanism: Move the closure-family allocation z to the minimum-face-variance point of the NSX-92 problem, with the signal-dependent noise (M1) as the only allocation-to-variance channel.

cost.description: capacity-weighted quadratic effort of the allocated torque history

representations.reason: muscle redundancy is not wired into the NSX-92 solve

name: Co-contraction and impedance
mechanism: Raise joint stiffness/damping (declared impedance windows, NSX-93) or antagonist co-contraction (short-range stiffness against signal-dependent noise, NSX-94).

cost.description: expected quadratic effort of the declared impedance / feedback torque (a separate line from the allocated torque, rule R10)

name: Distal stabilization near impact
mechanism: A declared impedance window that ends at impact (NSX-93), stabilizing late in the downswing only.

cost.description: expected quadratic effort of the declared impedance / feedback torque (a separate line from the allocated torque, rule R10)

representations.reason: no muscle-level evaluator exists for this mechanism

name: Proximal-distal effort shift
mechanism: Shift effort between proximal and distal joints at fixed clubhead speed.

cost.description: no cost model exists until the strategy is implemented

representations.reason: no muscle-level evaluator exists for this mechanism

name: Grip pressure and hand-split preload
mechanism: Redistribute the allocation through the geometric preload of the closure (M2) with additive noise, isolated from M1.

cost.description: capacity-weighted quadratic effort of the allocated torque history

representations.reason: the hand-club closure has no muscle-level model

name: Kinematic redundancy (UCM)
mechanism: Confine joint-space variability to the uncontrolled manifold of the clubhead outcome.

cost.description: no cost model exists until the strategy is implemented

representations.reason: UCM split exists (variability_ucm.ucm_decompose, NSX-97); no S6 arm turns it into a strategy parameter and cost

name: Delayed feedback
mechanism: Delayed state feedback with a declared gain schedule and sensorimotor delay (NSX-93), limited by its delay margin.

cost.description: expected quadratic effort of the declared impedance / feedback torque (a separate line from the allocated torque, rule R10)

representations.reason: no muscle-level evaluator exists for this mechanism

name: Speed-accuracy trade-off
mechanism: Trade clubhead speed for consistency: the variance of cases with different nominal speed at a common effort cap (NSX-92 CHS front).

name: Biarticular coupling
